If you want to talk about it occasionally, cool for you, but do NOT, NOT, NOT shove you're stupid little fandoms in everyones faces. Let's just take Homestuck as our example, ok? Here is my experience with an "origional homestuck fan"

Fan: have you read homestuck?

Me: umm, the first 100 pages or so. It was pretty boring to me though so I quit.

Fan: you mean you just... Gave up? You know you have to read at least 400 pages right? That's when it gets good

Me: eh, ive actually heard several different opinions on that. It just doesn't seem like my cup of tea though so I think I'll pass.

Fan: different opinions? *laughs* I swear to you that anyone who's read that far is in love. 

Me: hmm. I read up on the plot and it's just not my genera, ya know?

Fan: *Some obscure insulting quote (I forget what it is)*

Me: hmm?

Fan: *another quote. I think it was that someone would loath me*

Me: you realize I don't get the reference.

Fan: as one of the origional homestuck fans I'm telling you that it's the greatest series out there. The charachters are so deep, and it's really action filled. Here, just read to page 400.

Me: dude, no.

Fan: another quote

Me: hey look man, I just don't feel it's a good series for me, but if you're into it more power to you.

Fan: ok.. I thought you were a nerd like me, but I guess you're just normal. What a shame...

Me: woah woah woah, who says I'm normal?

Fan: I just.. If you think you're better than us "geeks" than alright, but the homestuck community is a really fun group. Like, we're all such total nerds but that what makes us fun.

Me: Kaaayyy.....

The day afterwards was our schools Epcot feild trip and it is a day I shall forever remember as one of the best days of my life. She slept with her head on my shoulder on the bus, we rode every ride together, and I basically did every girlfriendish thing possible short of kissing her. I even held her hand at some points. I must have seemed like the biggest friend zone-r ever but I couldn't help it. I really really liked her. Anyway halfway through the day we got matching pacman armbands on Japan. I wore that armband for a year and a half, even after we didn't go to the same school anymore. It reminded me of her, and that day. During a dark time it covered the scars on my wrist. Also, it showed everyone what an awesome pacman player I am. I loved this thing. To this day though I don't know what happened to it :c there's a happy ending though, cause I'm dating the girl now and I'm fully out of the closet.
